steps.label: 2284-own-paper1093-use-with-failed-item-save-once
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/paper/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('paperId')!=='1093'||document.querySelector('.modal.show')||window.__qaPaper1093UseAttempted)throw Error('Own paper edit only');const f=document.getElementById('paperModifyForm'),ids=[...f.querySelectorAll('[name=itemIds]')].map(e=>e.value);if(f.elements.paperId.value!=='1093'||f.elements.paperName.value!=='QA-HML-20261109-01-SET'||ids.join(',')!=='2089215,2089216'||!f.querySelector('[name=viewFlag][value=Y]:checked')||f.elements.startPageNum.value!=='2'||f.elements.endPageNum.value!=='22'||!f.checkValidity())throw Error('Own mixed paper baseline mismatch');window.__qaPaper1093UseAttempted=true;f.querySelector('[data-paper-save]').click();return {clickedOnce:true,paperId:1093,viewFlag:'Y',itemIds:ids,serviceDeployment:false};})()
